category_a_business.overview: 타겟 코퍼레이션은 미국 전역에서 다양한 상품을 판매하는 대형 소매업체입니다.
milestones: 1990년대: 자체 브랜드 및 독점 디자인 협력 강화
2010년대: 소형 매장 포맷 도입 및 옴니채널 전략 강화
category_a_business.business_model: 매장 및 디지털 채널을 통해 다양한 상품을 판매하여 수익을 창출합니다.
category_a_business.value_chain_position: Downstream + 최종 소비자에게 직접 상품을 판매하는 소매업체입니다.
category_a_business.key_customers: 고객 집중도 낮음 (수백만 명의 일반 소비자를 대상으로 함)

competitive_advantages: Consumer Defensive / Discount Stores 카테고리 — yfinance peer 비교 권장

top_risks.description: The following risks, some of which have occurred and any of which may occur in the future, could materially and adversely affect our business and financial performance.
These are not the only risks we face and there may be other risks that could materially and adversely affect our business and financial performance.
Competitive and Reputational Risks If we are unable to positively differentiate ourselves from our competitors, our results of operations and financial condition could be adversely affected.
If we fail to differentiate our guest experience from our competitors, our results of operations and financial condition could be adversely affected.
Since consumers can quickly comparison shop using digital tools, they may make decisions based solely on price or convenience, which could limit our ability to differentiate from our competitors.
If we are unable to offset our investments in these or other initiatives with improved performance or efficiencies, our results of operations could be adversely affected.

wikipedia_summary: Target Corporation is an American retail corporation headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota, United States. Target operates small-format and large-format retail stores and hypermarkets. It is the eighth-largest retailer in the U.S. and a component of the S&P 500 Index.
